_contract: Store-gallery shot list with captions in the Keeper's voice (terse, second person, archaic lean, ellipses, no exclamation marks). caption/alt are EN source strings: localize them, never rewrite this file for a locale - a localized media caption travels with its own-language capture pass (see the ru entries in variants). Captions are store/press text only and are NEVER burned into the PNG (Play applies its own overlay) - see store/screenshot-plan-detailed.md section 3. artifact paths are the delivered frames; status mirrors that plan's status table (section 0.5). id is the join key to the plan: never renumber.

shots.title: The hook - light vs. the dark
shots.caption: One lamp against the whole night... and the street remembers morning.
shots.alt: Warm streetlight pools recede down Maple Row toward the camera; past the north exit the road is black.

variants.caption: Один фонарь против всей ночи... и улица вспоминает утро.

shots.title: One city - a district boundary
shots.caption: You saved this block. Ahead, the dark keeps its own counsel...
shots.alt: Standing at the residential barricade facing the park: lit residential block behind, black trees and pond ahead, one brass lamp at the edge.

shots.title: Stealth horror
shots.caption: The light shows you the way... and shows you to it.
shots.alt: Player crouched at the edge of a flashlight pool on the playground chalk-lamp; a tall shadow waits just outside the light.

shots.title: The voice - keeper lore
shots.caption: A voice on the shortwave... someone still keeps the night honest.
shots.alt: Close on the keeper's shed bench: one brass work lamp, a shortwave radio, scattered papers.

shots.title: Restored world, nobody home
shots.caption: The pumps are dead. The canopy burns... and nobody comes to pay.
shots.alt: Empty wet forecourt under the canopy's sodium light; pump displays dark, the queue road black beyond.

shots.title: The mystery inside
shots.caption: The bench is warm. Whoever worked here... did not come back.
shots.alt: One warm lamp burning over an empty work bench in the dark industrial plant, no operator.

shots.title: The ending - the last streetlight
shots.caption: The gate lamp burns... and the city answers, one street at a time.
shots.alt: Wide view from the cooling-tower gantry: towers lit from below, the station gate lamp glowing at the foot.

shots.title: Scope and localization - the city map
shots.caption: Eleven rings. Count them... count what you gave back.
shots.alt: The in-game city map: the chain of 11 districts, most rings lit, one still dark.

variants.caption: Одиннадцать колец. Сосчитай их... и сосчитай, что ты вернул.

shots.title: Phone - first light, touch HUD
shots.caption: First light. Yours to carry now...
shots.alt: Phone touch HUD over the suburbs at first light: virtual joystick, action buttons, health, stamina and battery bars.

shots.title: Phone - crouch, stealth read
shots.caption: Crouch low. Let the dark forget your name...
shots.alt: Crouched player in a residential courtyard with the stealth read visible on the touch HUD.

shots.title: Phone - one-tap fix, interact glyph
shots.caption: One switch... and the street owes you a light.
shots.alt: Player at a residential power switch with the interact glyph pulsing on the touch HUD.
